scientific_limitations: The global optimum is proved among all symmetric stochastic matrices, but optimizer uniqueness and the complete optimizer-face statement are only within the graph-invariant subclass.
No nonreversible chains or arbitrary edge-cost patterns are covered. The unpriced benchmark and crown-graph spectral endpoint are pre-existing results.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed; equivalent specialized results may exist beyond the inspected literature.
title: Exact priced-matching Pareto frontier for symmetric mixing on balanced complete bipartite graphs
